Metadata.title: Neighborly - Trust-Based Ride Sharing
Metadata.description: Connect with trusted drivers in your community. Safe, flexible, and built on relationships.

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: By accessing or using Neighborly's mobile application and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our platform.
s1.p2: These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Neighborly. We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time, and your continued use constitutes acceptance of any changes.

s2.heading: 2. Service Description
s2.intro: Neighborly is a trust-based ride-sharing platform that connects riders with verified drivers through community "tribes." Our platform facilitates:

items.i3: Ride booking and driver matching within tribes

s2.outro: Neighborly acts as a technology platform connecting independent drivers with riders. We do not provide transportation services directly and are not a transportation carrier.

s1Items.i1: You must be at least 18 years of age
s1Items.i2: You must provide accurate and complete registration information
s1Items.i3: You must maintain the security of your account credentials
s1Items.i4: You must comply with all applicable laws and regulations

s2Items.i1: Valid driver's license and vehicle registration
s2Items.i3: Proof of vehicle insurance meeting minimum requirements
s2Items.i4: Vehicle meeting safety and condition standards
s2Items.i5: Compliance with all local transportation regulations

s4.heading: 4. Tribe System
s4.s1Body: Drivers create tribes and receive unique QR codes to share with prospective riders. Drivers are responsible for managing their tribe membership and maintaining trust within their community.
s4.s2Body: Riders join tribes by scanning a driver's QR code. Riders may belong to multiple tribes. Tribe membership does not guarantee ride availability or acceptance.
s4.s3Body: Drivers may remove riders from their tribe at any time. Neighborly reserves the right to remove users from tribes or the platform for violations of these terms or safety concerns.

items.i1: Riders request rides through the app, selecting from their tribe drivers
items.i2: Drivers have sole discretion to accept or decline ride requests
items.i3: Accepted rides create a binding commitment for both parties
items.i4: Cancellations made after a driver has accepted a ride may result in a cancellation fee, which will be disclosed in the app before you confirm the cancellation
items.i5: Drivers must complete accepted rides unless safety concerns arise

s6.heading: 6. Payment Terms
s6.s1Body: Ride prices are calculated based on distance, time, and demand. Drivers may set their own rates within platform guidelines. All prices are displayed before ride confirmation.
s6.s2Body: Payments may be made before or after rides as agreed between rider and driver. Neighborly processes payments through secure third-party providers and charges a service fee on each transaction.
s6.s3Body: Refund requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis. Disputes should be reported within 48 hours of ride completion. Neighborly's decision on refunds is final.

s8.heading: 8. Safety and Insurance
s8.p1: Drivers must maintain appropriate insurance coverage. Neighborly does not provide insurance for rides. Users participate at their own risk and should review their personal insurance policies.
s8.p2: Report safety concerns immediately through the app's emergency features. Neighborly investigates all safety reports and may suspend or terminate accounts pending investigation.

s9.heading: 9. Intellectual Property
s9.p1: All content, trademarks, and intellectual property on the Neighborly platform are owned by Neighborly or licensed to us. You may not use, copy, or distribute our intellectual property without written permission.
s9.p2: Our marketing materials, including website and promotional videos, may feature AI-generated characters and scenarios. These depictions are synthetic and do not represent real Neighborly riders, drivers, or any other actual person. Any resemblance to any real individual is coincidental and unintentional.

s10.heading: 10. Limitation of Liability
s10.intro: Neighborly provides the platform "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for:

items.i1: Actions or omissions of drivers or riders
items.i2: Accidents, injuries, or property damage during rides
items.i4: Loss of data or unauthorized account access

s10.outro: Our total liability is limited to the amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim.

s11.heading: 11. Indemnification
s11.body: You agree to indemnify and hold Neighborly harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the platform, violation of these terms, or violation of any rights of third parties.

s12.heading: 12. Termination
s12.p1: We may suspend or terminate your account at any time for violations of these terms, safety concerns, or fraudulent activity. You may terminate your account at any time through the app settings.
s12.p2: Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately. Provisions regarding liability, indemnification, and dispute resolution survive termination.

s13.p1: Any disputes arising from these terms or use of the platform shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
s13.p2: You waive the right to participate in class action lawsuits. This arbitration agreement does not preclude seeking relief in small claims court.

Safety.title: Safety Guidelines
Safety.subtitle: Your safety is our top priority

commitment.heading: Our Commitment to Safety
commitment.body: Neighborly is built on trust and community. We've implemented comprehensive safety measures to protect both riders and drivers. While our tribe-based system creates trusted connections, we encourage all users to follow these safety guidelines.

backgroundChecks.heading: Background Checks
backgroundChecks.intro: All drivers undergo comprehensive background checks before joining Neighborly, including:

items.i1: Annual vehicle inspection and safety certification
Verify the driver's profile photo matches the person picking you up
items.i2: Check the vehicle make, model, color, and license plate
items.i3: Share your trip details with a trusted friend or family member
items.i4: Wait in a safe, well-lit location
items.i5: Never share personal contact information before the ride
items.i6: Trust your instincts - cancel if something feels wrong

items.i1: Confirm the rider's identity before starting the trip
items.i2: Ensure your vehicle is clean and in good working condition
items.i3: Keep your profile information and photo up to date
items.i4: Plan your route in advance using the app's navigation
items.i6: Never accept rides outside the platform

items.i2: Sit in the back seat when riding alone
items.i4: Follow the GPS route provided by the app
items.i6: Avoid distractions - no phone use while driving

redFlags.heading: Red Flags
redFlags.intro: End the ride immediately and report if:

items.i1: The driver appears impaired or drives recklessly
items.i2: The route deviates significantly without explanation
items.i4: The driver makes inappropriate comments or advances

helpCenter.heading: Help & Safety Center
helpCenter.body: Every account has access to an in-app Help & Safety Center with safety guidance and a one-tap "Contact Support" button that opens an email to our support team.

shareTrip.heading: Share Your Trip
shareTrip.body: Before you get in the car, share your driver's name, vehicle details, and trip plans with a friend or family member using your phone's messaging apps.

ratings.heading: Ratings & Feedback
ratings.body: After a trip, riders can rate their driver and submit feedback. Neighborly may review reported concerns and take appropriate account action.

teamSupport.heading: Safety Team Support
teamSupport.body: For immediate danger, always call 911 first. The in-app Help & Safety Center is available anytime, and our safety team reviews and responds to reports during business hours (Monday - Friday, 9am - 6pm Central Time).

tribeSafety.heading: Tribe Safety
tribeSafety.intro: The tribe system creates trusted communities, but safety remains everyone's responsibility:

items.i1: Drivers should only share QR codes with people they trust
items.i2: Riders should join tribes of drivers they know or who come recommended
items.i3: Report any suspicious behavior within your tribe
items.i4: Drivers can remove riders from their tribe at any time
items.i5: Multiple tribe memberships provide backup options

howToReport.heading: How to Report
howToReport.appCenter: The in-app Help & Safety Center ("Contact Support")

whatHappensNext.heading: What Happens Next
whatHappensNext.intro: All safety reports are taken seriously:

items.i1: Immediate review by our safety team
items.i2: Account suspension pending investigation for serious violations
items.i3: Cooperation with law enforcement when necessary
items.i5: Permanent ban for confirmed safety violations

items.i1: Follow local health guidelines and regulations
items.i2: Wear masks when required or requested
items.i5: Respect others' health preferences and boundaries

insurance.heading: Insurance and Liability
insurance.p1: Drivers must maintain appropriate insurance coverage. Neighborly does not provide insurance for rides. Review your personal insurance policy to understand coverage during ride-sharing activities.
insurance.p2: In case of accidents, exchange insurance information and file a police report. Contact our support team for assistance with incident documentation.

communityStandards.heading: Community Standards
communityStandards.intro: Neighborly is built on mutual respect and trust. We expect all users to:

items.i1: Treat others with courtesy and respect
items.i4: Follow all traffic laws and regulations
items.i6: Honor commitments and arrive on time

remember.heading: Remember
remember.body: Your safety is paramount. Trust your instincts. If something doesn't feel right, it probably isn't. Don't hesitate to cancel a ride, end a trip early, or contact emergency services. The in-app Help & Safety Center is available anytime, and our team is ready to help during business hours.

getInTouch.body: Have questions about Neighborly? Need support with your account? Want to partner with us? We're here to help.

becomeDriver.question: How do I become a driver?
becomeDriver.answer: Download the Neighborly app and complete the driver application. You'll need to pass a background check and provide vehicle documentation. Once approved, you can start building your tribe!

joinTribe.question: How do I join a driver's tribe?
joinTribe.answer: Ask a verified Neighborly driver for their QR code. Scan it in the app to join their tribe and start booking rides with them.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and digital payment methods. You can pay before or after your ride, depending on your arrangement with your driver.

availability.question: Is Neighborly available in my city?
availability.answer: We're rapidly expanding across the US. Download the app to see if we're available in your area, or contact us to request service in your city.

s1.heading: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Welcome to Neighborly. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our trust-based ride-sharing platform.
s1.p2: Neighborly connects riders and drivers through community-based "tribes" built on trust and verified backgrounds. This policy applies to all users of our mobile application and services.

s1Items.i3: Payment information (processed securely through third-party providers)
s1Items.i4: Driver's license and vehicle information (for drivers)

s3Items.i2: Tribe memberships and QR code interactions

About.title: About Neighborly
About.subtitle: Building trust-based communities, one ride at a time

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.p1: At Neighborly, we believe that transportation should be built on trust, not transactions. We're reimagining ride-sharing by creating community-based "tribes" where riders and drivers know and trust each other, making every journey safer, more personal, and more connected.
mission.p2: Our platform empowers drivers to build their own trusted networks through background-verified profiles and QR code invitations, while giving riders the peace of mind that comes from riding with people they know and trust.

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: Neighborly was founded in 2024 with a simple observation: traditional ride-sharing had lost the human connection. Riders and drivers were strangers, and every trip felt transactional. We asked ourselves, "What if ride-sharing could feel more like carpooling with a neighbor?"
story.p2: From this question, the concept of "tribes" was born. By allowing drivers to create their own verified networks and riders to join multiple trusted communities, we've created a platform where safety and familiarity go hand in hand.
story.p3: Today, Neighborly is growing across communities nationwide, connecting thousands of riders and drivers who value trust, flexibility, and genuine human connection in their daily commutes.

trust.title: Trust First
trust.description: Every driver undergoes comprehensive background checks, and every tribe is built on verified connections. Trust isn't just a feature—it's our foundation.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: We believe in the power of local communities. Our tribe system puts control in the hands of drivers and riders, creating networks that reflect real relationships.

safety.title: Safety Always
safety.description: From background checks to real-time tracking and emergency support, we've built multiple layers of safety into every aspect of the Neighborly experience.

flexibility.title: Flexibility & Choice
flexibility.description: Riders can join multiple tribes and choose their preferred driver. Drivers can accept or decline rides based on their availability. Everyone has control over their experience.

team.heading: Our Team
team.p1: Neighborly is built by a diverse team of technologists, community organizers, and transportation innovators who share a passion for creating safer, more connected communities.
team.p2: We're headquartered in Austin, Texas, but our team works remotely across the country, staying connected to the communities we serve. We're always looking for talented individuals who share our vision—check out our careers page to join us!

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.intro: Have questions about Neighborly? We'd love to hear from you.
